{"settings":"{
    "editor.mouseWheelZoom": true,
    "gitlens.ai.model": "vscode",
    "gitlens.ai.vscode.model": "copilot:gpt-4.1",
    "explorer.confirmDelete": false,
    "[javascriptreact]": {
        "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
    },
    "cheerleader.health.breakReminderEnabled": false,
    "cheerleader.paste.monitoringEnabled": false,
    "cheerleader.productivity.monitoringEnabled": false,
    "cheerleader.encouragement.enabled": false,
    "[javascript]": {
        "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
    },
    "javascript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
    "debug.console.fontSize": 16,
    "terminal.integrated.fontSize": 16,
    "chat.editor.fontSize": 16,
    "chat.fontSize": 16,
    "workbench.iconTheme": "material-icon-theme",
    "workbench.colorTheme": "Best Themes - Poimandres Black",
    "explorer.confirmPasteNative": false,
    "git.openRepositoryInParentFolders": "never",
    "google-translate.firstLanguage": "en",
    "liveServer.settings.donotShowInfoMsg": true,
    "claudeCode.preferredLocation": "panel",
    "editor.unicodeHighlight.invisibleCharacters": false,
    "editor.unicodeHighlight.ambiguousCharacters": false,
    "editor.mouseWheelScrollSensitivity": 3,
    "github.copilot.nextEditSuggestions.enabled": false,
    "github.copilot.enable": {
        "*": false,
        "plaintext": false,
        "markdown": false,
        "scminput": false,
        "postcss": false
    }
,
"material-code.primaryColor": "#626DF1",
"explorer.confirmDragAndDrop": false,
"editor.fontFamily": "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font",
"terminal.integrated.fontFamily": "JetBrainsMono Nerd Font",
"code-runner.runInTerminal": true,
"doki.wallpaper.enabled": false,
"doki.background.enabled": false,
"doki.sticker.css": "z-index:10;background-position:100% 99%",
"typescript.updateImportsOnFileMove.enabled": "always",
"redhat.telemetry.enabled": false,
"[json]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.json-language-features"
},
"[html]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "vscode.html-language-features"
},
"roo-cline.debug": false,
"roo-cline.allowedCommands": [
    "git log",
    "git diff",
    "git show"
],
"roo-cline.deniedCommands": [],
"markdown.extension.toc.updateOnSave": false,
"files.associations": {
    "*.cpp": "cpp"
},
"[cpp]": {

    
    "editor.wordBasedSuggestions": "off",
    "editor.semanticHighlighting.enabled": true,
    "editor.stickyScroll.defaultModel": "foldingProviderModel",
    "editor.suggest.insertMode": "replace",
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "psycha0s.cpp-format"
},
"chat.tools.terminal.autoApprove": {
    "cmake": true
},
"google-translate.secondLanguage": "en",
"[typescriptreact]": {
    "editor.defaultFormatter": "esbenp.prettier-vscode"
},
"C_Cpp.default.cppStandard": "c++20",
"C_Cpp.default.cStandard": "c17",
"code-runner.executorMap": {
    "cpp": "cd $dir && g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -Wall $fileName -o $fileNameWithoutExt.exe && .\\$fileNameWithoutExt.exe < input.in > output.out"
},
"code-runner.runInTerminal": true,
"editor.formatOnSave": true,
"files.autoSave": "afterDelay"
}"}
